status: 359 repeat-identical original BMP import/source/preparation cases and six complete native GUI conversions match. Full format/application parity remains unfinished.
contract: Own decoded BGRA bytes, intrinsic matte and dimensions must match original raw/source/working/preparation bytes. Support packed palettes and truecolor storage through native row ordering and Q8 bitfield expansion. Do not use reference pixels as runtime input. Preserve the existing failing BMP/PNG suite.
authority: Microsoft defines layout; original captures and REA define legacy pixel behavior. Source mirror is causal context, not asserted identical linked source.
remaining: Multi-image arrays beyond the first raster, metadata/color profiles, malformed and truncated files, exact errors and full-word mask undefined/hanging native behavior require further investigation. Full application and Rust/GPUI parity remain unproven.

supported.storage: Indexed palettes, RGB555 defaults, BI_BITFIELDS, RGB24, RGB32, RLE4 and RLE8, both row directions, reduced declared palettes and native palette strides. BM and CI identifiers and nested BA prefixes decode their first raster.
supported.nativeQuirks: Preserve cached matte before BI_RGB resets masks, native opacity inversion, 52-byte alpha read from following storage, 64-byte three-byte palette entries, BA root-relative palette/pixel offsets, ignored 24-bit masks and Q8 bitfield rounding.
supported.exhaustive: Three 256-by-256 matrices cover all 65,536 packed 16-bit values under RGB555, RGB565 and RGBA4444.
supported.rle: Encoded/absolute commands, nibble ordering, word padding, EOL, delta, early EOB and zero-filled tight raster.

rea.scope: REA projected function covers noncontiguous native ranges and does not establish the entire pixel import path. Exact native byte captures establish observed behavior.
